metadata.question: Did the nighttime brightness at Biju Patnaik Airport decrease more than the brightness at Saheed Nagar (20.290813, 85.848691) between April 30, 2019 and May 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about nighttime brightness changes at two specific locations (Biju Patnaik Airport and Saheed Nagar) between April 30, 2019 and May 5, 2019. This requires: 1. Data: VIIRS nighttime lights data (VNP46A2) which provides DNB radiance values 2. Locations: - Biju Patnaik Airport (need coordinates) - Saheed Nagar (20.290813, 85.848691) - given 3. Time: April 30, 2019 to May 5, 2019 (6 days) 4. Logic: Calculate brightness change for both locations and compare I need to: - Get coordinates for Biju Patnaik Airport (approx 20.2543, 85.8178) - Get VIIRS data for both locations - Calculate brightness at start and end dates - Compare the changes For data quality: - Check if collections exist (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after masking (C2) - Validate the calculated changes (C3) The question asks if the decrease at the airport was "more than" at Saheed Nagar, so I need to compare the magnitude of negative changes. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define locations const airport = ee.Geometry.Point([85.8178, 20.2543]); // Biju Patnaik Airport const saheed = ee.Geometry.Point([85.848691, 20.290813]); // Saheed Nagar // Define date range const startDate = '2019-04-30'; const endDate = '2019-05-05'; // Get VIIRS nighttime lights data const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); // Check collection size const count = viirs.size().getInfo(); if (count === 0) { print("No VIIRS images found in date range"); print("C1"); return; } print(`VIIRS Images: ${count}`); // Function to get brightness for a location function getBrightness(location, name) { const first = viirs.filterDate('2019-04-30', '2019-05-01').first(); const last = viirs.filterDate('2019-05-04', '2019-05-06').first(); if (!first || !last) { print(`${name}: Missing start or end image`); return null; } const firstVal = first.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: location, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const lastVal = last.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: location, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels if (firstVal === null || lastVal === null) { print(`${name}: No valid pixels`); return null; } const change = lastVal - firstVal; print(`${name}: ${firstVal.toFixed(2)} -> ${lastVal.toFixed(2)} (Δ: ${change.toFixed(2)})`); return change; } // Get brightness changes const airportChange = getBrightness(airport, "Airport"); const saheedChange = getBrightness(saheed, "Saheed"); // Validate results if (airportChange === null || saheedChange === null) { print("Missing data for one or both locations"); print("C2"); return; } if (!isFinite(airportChange) || !isFinite(saheedChange)) { print("Invalid calculation result"); print("C3"); return; } // Compare changes - looking for greater decrease (more negative) const airportDecreasedMore = airportChange < saheedChange; print(`Airport Δ: ${airportChange.toFixed(2)}`); print(`Saheed Δ: ${saheedChange.toFixed(2)}`); if (airportDecreasedMore) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
